detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 video

The usual suspect when a server's disk fills up at 3 AM: the systemd journal.

journalctl --disk-usage shows how big it got
sudo journalctl --vacuum-size=2G trims it right now
SystemMaxUse=2G in /etc/systemd/journald.conf keeps it there

The video is the same fix done from a chat: Termalin's alert lands in Telegram, the chat runs du and journalctl on the server through a Termalin Connector, and the alert clears by itself.

#linux #sysadmin #devops #systemd
